description: Investigator-assigned study identifier for the TB cohort (format TB-YYYY-NNN).
Patient's legal last name.
Patient's legal first name.
Social Security number
column3: held locally by the site for death-index and disease-registry linkage prior to de-identification.

description: Full date of birth.
Residential street address.
Residential city.
Residential US state
Residential 5-digit ZIP code.
Age in years at TB disease onset
Sex recorded at birth -- 'Sex' in both RVCT and TB Portals.
Race per OMB categories.
Hispanic or Latino ethnicity per OMB categories.
Country of birth. Foreign-born status is the dominant US TB epidemiology risk factor per CDC NTSS surveillance.
Years of US residence for foreign-born patients; 'N/A' for US-born patients (RVCT field).
Date the patient was registered into the TB program/surveillance system
column3: ahead of confirmed diagnosis. Modeled on TB Portals' 'Registration Date' field.

description: Date TB disease was confirmed
column3: distinct from program registration and treatment start.

description: WHO/RVCT case-registration category: New, Relapse, Treatment after failure, Treatment after loss to follow-up, or Transferred in. Modeled on TB Portals' 'Case Definition' field.
ICD-10-CM tuberculosis diagnosis code (A15-A19 range), e.g. A15.0 pulmonary TB, A18.2 tuberculous peripheral lymphadenopathy. Modeled on TB Portals' 'Diagnosis Code' field.
Anatomic site of TB disease: pulmonary, extrapulmonary (with site), or both. Equivalent to TB Portals' 'Localization' field.
Acid-fast bacilli sputum smear microscopy result; 'N/A' when the site of disease is exclusively extrapulmonary.
Mycobacterial culture result confirming M. tuberculosis.
Chest radiograph finding, e.g. cavitary or non-cavitary infiltrate, pleural effusion, or normal.

Drug-susceptibility testing (DST) result summary, e.g. pan-susceptible, isoniazid-resistant, rifampin-resistant (RR-TB), or multidrug-resistant (MDR-TB). Equivalent to TB Portals' 'DST Profile' field.
HIV coinfection status, a standard RVCT/NTSS and TB Portals TB surveillance data element.
Non-HIV comorbidity most relevant to TB treatment and prognosis, e.g. diabetes mellitus, alcohol use disorder, chronic malnutrition, or none. Modeled on TB Portals' broader 'Comorbidity' field.
Anti-TB drug regimen prescribed, e.g. first-line HRZE (isoniazid, rifampin, pyrazinamide, ethambutol) or a second-line MDR/RR-TB regimen. Modeled on TB Portals' 'Regimen Drugs' field.
Date the anti-TB treatment regimen began.
Date the treatment regimen ended (completion
column4: or last contact before loss to follow-up); 'Ongoing' when the patient is still on treatment.

description: Final treatment outcome: completed, died, lost to follow-up, or still on treatment. Equivalent to TB Portals' 'Outcome' field.
